# GitHub repository metadata

GitHub repository description and topics are configured in the repository's
**About** settings. This note records the intended values; committing it does
not change the settings automatically.

## Description

```text
Eclipse-based, evidence-aware IDE for Zephyr RTOS development — hardware visualization, Kconfig/Devicetree diagnosis, SVD register inspection, build & debug integrity safeguards.
```

## Topics

```text
zephyr, rtos, eclipse-plugin, embedded, kconfig, devicetree, cmsis-svd, gdb, openocd, stm32, esp32, nrf, mspm0
```

## Maintainer checklist (GitHub UI)

- [ ] Open the repository page and select the **Edit** (gear) control in **About**.
- [ ] Paste the description above into **Description** without changing its wording.
- [ ] Add the 13 topics listed above under **Topics**.
- [ ] Save the repository details.
